description:
Create an account and get an API key with free credits. Needs a beta access code
    (access_code, HD-XXXX-XXXX; case and dashes do not matter): without one the error is
    403 access_code_required, and a code that does not work is 403 invalid_access_code.
    Ask for a code with request_access, or at hookdetector.com/access. No key needed for
    this call. label is an optional note up to 120 characters.

    Keep the api_key it returns: it is the only copy. Send it as the header
    'Authorization: Bearer hd_...' or pass it as api_key on every other tool. Signups,
    and wrong codes, are limited per address per hour. Next step: find_hooks.
name: create_account
